title: At a US House hearing, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said AI labs should get no liability exemptions and called for more open-source models built in the US (Matt Bracken/FedScoop)
summary: Matt Bracken / FedScoop: At a US House hearing, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said AI labs should get no liability exemptions and called for more open-source models built in the US — The secretary told House Financial Services Committee lawmakers that the “best way to guarantee safety” is for AI creators to be held …
